Name: Old Cola Interface
Author: deleted177903810
Description:
This mod was inspired by faded cola labels.

[b][size=6]Installation[/size][/b]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Download and extract this file.
3. Copy the folder '[CP] Old Cola Interface' into your 'Mods' folder.
4. Run SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Old Cola Interface
Manifest.Description: Gives Stardew Valley's UI a washed out red and copper palette.
Manifest.Author: radiodeath
